37434f3b-99ed-4b87-8bc0-be404c154d18.name: 查询国际新闻
37434f3b-99ed-4b87-8bc0-be404c154d18.sql: SELECT news_id, news_time, region, event FROM intl_news WHERE region LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') AND news_time >= #{start_time} AND news_time <= #{end_time} ORDER BY news_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
37434f3b-99ed-4b87-8bc0-be404c154d18.description: 根据区域和时间范围查询国际新闻，支持分页

7bbe876a-064d-4bb3-8424-2f12ebe87932.name: 查询商品库存信息
7bbe876a-064d-4bb3-8424-2f12ebe87932.sql: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, STOCK, PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE STOCK < #{threshold} ORDER BY STOCK ASC LIMIT #{limit}

f1d7f5b6-fe31-49a0-ab37-b3b752b9a5d7.name: 查询指定地区历史航班动用情况
f1d7f5b6-fe31-49a0-ab37-b3b752b9a5d7.sql: SELECT t.support_id, t.support_time, t.region, t.transport_info, d.equip_model, d.sorties, d.batches FROM transport_support t LEFT JOIN dispatch_force d ON t.support_id = d.support_id WHERE t.region = #{region} ORDER BY t.support_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
f1d7f5b6-fe31-49a0-ab37-b3b752b9a5d7.description: 根据指定地区查询历史所有航班动用情况，包括支援时间、装备型号、出动架次和批次信息

fcf9a268-9956-40d4-a3d9-8a33ff2653ec.name: 查询指定装备的历史活动时间
fcf9a268-9956-40d4-a3d9-8a33ff2653ec.sql: SELECT df.dispatch_id, df.support_id, df.equip_model, df.sorties, df.batches, ts.support_time, ts.region, ts.transport_info FROM dispatch_force df JOIN transport_support ts ON df.support_id = ts.support_id WHERE df.equip_model = #{equipModel} ORDER BY ts.support_time DESC
fcf9a268-9956-40d4-a3d9-8a33ff2653ec.description: 根据指定装备型号，查询其对应的历史调度与运输支持记录，包括活动时间、区域及详情信息
